snippet.title: What If You Farted in a Spacesuit? 💨🚀
snippet.description:
You just farted in a spacesuit. No up, no escape, and your hands are stuck in giant gloves. 💨🚀 Could it push you like a rocket? Could it catch fire? And how long until it's gone?

Would you rather share a spacesuit with your own fart, or a space station with someone else's? Tell us below 👇

An imagined scenario, just for fun.

• NASA flatulence research in the Apollo era: hydrogen and methane in astronaut diets and spacecraft cabins
